name: ui-sounds
title: UI Sounds
description: A declarative synthesizer for interface sounds: describe a sound as data, play it from React with a provider, hooks, mute and volume, or render it offline. Includes the Core sound pack and works offline.
label: audio by Raphael Salaja
author: Raphael Salaja <https://github.com/raphaelsalaja>
attribution: audio, Copyright (c) 2026 Raphael Salaja. MIT License.

loop.script: hover[3] → press[3] → release[3] → hover[9] → press[9] → release[9] → idle

props.name: SoundProvider enabled
props.description: Whether sounds may play. Controlled: keep it in your own state and update it from onEnabledChange.

props.name: SoundProvider volume
props.description: Master volume multiplier from 0 to 1, applied to every sound played below the provider.

props.name: SoundProvider respectReducedMotion
props.description: Labs addition. Upstream keeps the hooks silent while the user prefers reduced motion; pass false to let your own mute control decide.

props.name: SoundProvider onEnabledChange / onVolumeChange
props.description: Called when a child (such as SoundControls) asks for a change.

props.name: useSound(definition, options?)
props.description: A stable callback that plays one sound definition. Returns undefined when muted. Call it from an event handler.

props.name: usePatch(patch)
props.description: A patch (an object, or a URL fetched on mount) whose play(name, options?) respects the provider. Pass corePatch for the bundled pack.

props.name: useSequence(steps, options?)
props.description: Stable play and stop callbacks for a timed sequence of sounds, optionally looping.

props.name: useSoundControls()
props.description: Labs addition. Reads the provider so a switch and slider can sit anywhere below it. silenced is true while reduced motion keeps sounds off.

props.name: SoundControls
props.description: Labs addition. A sound switch and volume slider; explains the reduced-motion silence and offers Play anyway when onOverride is set.

props.name: defineSound(definition)
props.description: The vanilla API (@/lib/ui-sounds-api): bind a sound definition into a function that plays it on the shared audio context.

props.name: renderToBuffer(definition, { duration, sampleRate?, numberOfChannels? })
props.description: Renders a sound offline with OfflineAudioContext, with no speakers involved; renderToWav encodes it as a WAV blob.

props.name: corePatch
props.description: The Core pack, 62 interface sounds (click, toggle-on, success, error, swoosh and more), bundled as data.

a11y: Nothing plays on its own: every sound starts from a handler you call (a click, key or tap), and the shared audio context is created the first time one plays.
SoundControls is a labelled switch and a labelled range input; both work with the keyboard and keep their visible text in their accessible name.

Sound is not motion, but upstream keeps the hooks silent under prefers-reduced-motion. That stays the default; SoundControls says so while it applies and offers Play anyway, and respectReducedMotion={false} turns the rule off.
Give users a way to turn sound off or lower it (WCAG 2.2 audio control): render SoundControls or your own switch bound to the provider.
Do not rely on a sound alone to convey information; pair it with a visible or announced change.
usage:
<SoundProvider enabled={on} volume={volume} onEnabledChange={setOn} onVolumeChange={setVolume}>
  <SoundControls />
  <PlayButton />
</SoundProvider>

function PlayButton() {
  const patch = usePatch(corePatch);
  return <button type="button" onClick={() => patch.play("success")}>Save</button>;
}
